summary_en: 1,364,200 shares (1.2% of shares outstanding) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 at ¥1,466/share on 2026-06-03, representing approximately ¥2.0B. Block transaction under authorization to acquire up to 8M shares (7.1% S/O) for ¥10B through 2027-03-31.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: Nihon Parkerizing announced on 2 June 2026 that it will acquire up to 1,364,200 of its own shares (1.2% of shares outstanding) via ToSTNeT-3 off-hours trading on 3 June 2026 at the closing price of ¥1,466 per share, resulting in a total acquisition of approximately ¥2.0 billion. This block purchase is part of a broader authorization approved by the board on 14 May 2026 to acquire up to 8 million shares (7.1% of S/O) for a maximum of ¥10 billion through 31 March 2027 using open-market purchases and ToSTNeT-3 transactions. The specific block transaction will be executed during the morning session at 08:45 JST; results will be announced immediately after the trading session closes. The acquisition is contingent on matched sell orders being available in the market.
